about_the_game:
I Love Gambling is an arcade style casino game for those who LOVE gambling!

You've had some bad days, but yesterday might have been the worst. In a stroke of bad luck, you accidentally fell for a scam and now find yourself a billion dollars in debt! Luckily, an unknown source sent you a computer that features unregulated casino games that you can bet money on - and you LOVE gambling.

Gamble your way out of your debt, use underhanded methods, and borrow even MORE money to meet your debtor deadlines, or risk getting kneecapped!

Features:

  • Debt deadlines. Your debtors are getting mad, and they're now starting to send out deadlines! Make sure you meet the deadlines, or else you risk deadly consequences...

  • Casino games. Gamble your savings and earnings away at a variety of different casino games! The more you spend, the higher stakes you can unlock!

  • Evil banks. Take out loans to help aid your gambling addictions! Just make sure you pay them on time...

  • The black market. When times are rough, you get rough too. Buy shady items from the dark web that are able to help influence your performance in different casino games! Just don't get caught...

  • Death. If you mess up too much... you'll die. Debt ain't a joke.
